purpose: Preserve typed call argument value IDs, result destinations, callee identity and internal/foreign ABI shape as semantic IR rather than lexical call aggregates.

logical_call.argument_rule: arguments are semantic value IDs in source evaluation order
logical_call.result_rule: result IDs are definitions owned by the defining call instruction

foreign_abi.lowering_rule: ABI register/stack placement is derived from the typed signature plus ordered semantic argument IDs, never from lexical token position.

verifier_requirements: callee identity resolves to exactly one internal or foreign declaration
argument count equals the resolved signature arity
each argument value ID is defined and type-compatible with its parameter
result count/type agrees with the resolved return type
result value IDs agree with W1/W2 definition ownership
foreign and internal call kinds cannot be silently interchanged
call records preserve complete source evaluation order
prohibited_shortcuts: use aggregate ast_call_count as semantic call records
store lexical identifier hashes instead of semantic argument value IDs
recover arguments by rereading source in the emitter
infer foreign ABI shape from call arity alone
